rules: All runtime-facing art uses logical asset IDs.
Reserve assets may remain unreferenced until promoted into playable content.
Child NPCs use age-appropriate proportions, schedules, dialogue, and roles.
Plush Guardians are inhabitants and companions, not harvestable monster resources.
Unique story assets receive state/expression variants instead of meaningless duplicates.
All map-facing assets must remain compatible with the 48px MV-inspired grid contract.
